# Program Engineer — Walt Disney World Resort

---
**Job ID:** 10161727
**Date Posted:** Oct 14, 2026
**Date Applied:** Oct 20, 2026
**Salary Range:** $92,400–$123,800 per year — Orlando, FL (role located in Lake Buena Vista, FL)
---

## Job Summary

A program engineering role in Global Engineering & Technology (GE&T) that moves programs from initial request through funding and execution. The Program Engineer partners with customers and engineering teams to define scope, develop proposals, coordinate resources, and remove roadblocks; manages smaller projects and opportunities while supporting Senior Program Engineers on larger, more complex programs; helps improve the tools and processes used to manage the portfolio; and serves as a key connection between GE&T Job Captains and customers across the organization. The role reports to the Manager, Project & IFP Support.

---

## What You'll Do

- Partner with customers to understand business needs, workflows, and opportunities for GE&T engineering support.
- Manage assigned projects and opportunities from Integrated Facility Planning (IFP) approval through project launch and execution, while supporting Senior Program Engineers on larger programs.
- Coordinate proposal development by aligning with resource managers, Job Captains, core team members, and customers to define scope and requirements.
- Consolidate engineering scope, assumptions, exclusions, and estimates into clear, comprehensive GE&T proposals, escalating gaps or concerns as needed.
- Review proposals and track outstanding customer approvals, authorizations, and funding through project launch.
- Monitor project budgets, proactively identify risks, and coordinate solutions, including change orders when needed.
- Lead regular portfolio reviews to maintain alignment across project status, scope, funding, and schedule, and drive outstanding items to resolution.
- Coordinate required approvals and business justifications, ensuring decisions and outcomes are clearly documented.
- Maintain and improve portfolio management tools, processes, and reporting to address gaps and improve visibility.
- Support annual Integrated Facilities Planning (IFP) and tiered review cycles, including coordinating and resolving comments in Bluebeam.
- Provide leadership with timely visibility into project status, risks, and open issues, including updates for Major Project Updates (MPU) and Gate Reviews.

### Required Qualifications
- 1+ years of experience in an engineering, technical, project, or related environment
- Experience supporting project management activities, including coordinating priorities, schedules, deliverables, or resources
- Experience developing, maintaining, or improving project tracking, reporting, or portfolio management tools
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify gaps, recommend solutions, and drive issues toward resolution
- Effective interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build partnerships across technical and operational teams
- Ability to work through ambiguity, gather needed information, and determine appropriate next steps
- Demonstrated initiative and sound judgment, including recognizing and escalating potential risks or issues
- Proven organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities
- Ability to communicate technical information clearly and tailor the level of detail for technical and non-technical audiences
- Preferred: experience with portfolio and markup tooling such as Smartsheet, Airtable, Bluebeam, SAP, and Maximo; contributing to a system migration or implementation, from data model through cutover; working in or with Facilities and Operations Services (FOS) departments; proven support for large programs

### Education
Bachelor's degree in an engineering or related field is required. Master's degree in engineering, business, or equivalent is preferred.

### Benefits
A rewards package that includes health and savings benefits, educational opportunities, and Disney perks. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and other benefits, depending on the level and position offered.

Customer training (THE KRAKEN) and cross-functional support back the technical-to-non-technical communication requirement.

## About the Company

The position is with Walt Disney Parks and Resorts U.S., Inc., part of the Walt Disney World Resort business, in Global Engineering & Technology (GE&T), working with Job Captains and customers across the organization. Lake Buena Vista is home to Disney Springs, Disney's Typhoon Lagoon Water Park, Disney's Lake Buena Vista Golf Course, and several resort hotels. The Walt Disney Company operates through three segments: Disney Entertainment, ESPN, and Disney Experiences.
